Footer.description: Virtual SMS numbers and social media services from Premium Verific.

Landing.badge: Virtual numbers and social media services
Landing.headline: Grow your online presence and find a virtual number
Landing.subtitle: Explore available SMS numbers and social media services. Review prices and service details before ordering.
Landing.smsPoint3: View received codes in your inbox
Landing.sectionIntro: Choose the service that fits your needs, then review availability and pricing.
Landing.smmBody: Browse services for Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and more. Read the terms for the specific service before placing an order.
Landing.smsBody: Select a service and country, check availability and receive supported verification messages in your account inbox.
Landing.accountsBody: Explore available account products and request help with eligible Facebook account recovery issues.
Landing.calculatorIntro: Select a platform and quantity to see an estimated price in XAF. The final price is checked before purchase.
Landing.faqIntro: Answers to common questions about our services.
Landing.faq1q: How do virtual SMS numbers work?
Landing.faq1a: Choose the supported service and country, review the price and purchase a number. Any received verification code appears in your account inbox. Acceptance depends on the third-party platform.
Landing.faq2q: How do social media services work?
Landing.faq2a: Choose a platform, specific service and quantity. Check the description, price and delivery terms before placing your order. Results and timing vary by service.
Landing.faq3q: Can you help with Facebook account recovery?
Landing.faq3a: You can submit a request about an account you own or are authorised to manage. Our team will review the details and explain what help is available.
Landing.faq4a: Open Add funds, choose an available payment method and follow the instructions. Wallet credit is added only after payment verification.
Landing.mobileBody: Access your numbers, message inbox and wallet on Android, or use the website on iPhone.
Landing.finalBody: Create an account to compare services, review prices and track your orders.
